title: Ovid2 formatter spec
description: Declarative formatter definition. One spec produces one CDM table for one pipeline. Loaded from pipelines/<pipeline>/formatters/<table>.yaml (or a Python-dict `spec(...)` call).

v.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.

formatter.description: CDM table name this formatter produces (snake_case).

enabled.description: When false, this table is skipped (replaces the legacy `_not_provided` filename suffix).

input_file_name.description: Glob pattern used by the input address when loading the primary source. Required unless adapter is `union_of_specs` or `custom` (which compute their own).

auxiliary_tables.description: Table names that must be registered as Spark temp views before this formatter runs.

sources.description: Named source blocks. Each becomes an aliased DataFrame the joins and projections can reference.

projections.description: Mapping of output column name (uppercase) -> SQL expression string.

post_expressions.description: Extra `selectExpr` items appended after `projections` (e.g. `case when CONDITION_TYPE = 'ICD10CM' then ... end as CONDITION_TYPE`).

output_columns_from.description: CDM schema reference like `pcornet_7_0.CONDITION`. Enforces the projected columns match the declared CDM table.

sub_specs.description: Only used when `adapter == 'union_of_specs'`. Each entry names another spec whose output is unioned.

class.description: Only used when `adapter == 'custom'`. Dotted path to a BaseFormatter subclass.

glob.description: File glob relative to the pipeline batch directory.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to subtract (matched by fnmatch on basename).

optional.description: When true, missing files do not fail the run.

filter.description: SQL predicate applied via .filter() before joins.

lowercase_columns.description: Normalize column names to lowercase at read time — fixes the recurring uppercase-header bug.

with.description: Name of another source, or the shared temp view (e.g. `concept`).

prefix.description: Prefix applied to every column of the right side after the join. Guarantees no ambiguous `concept_id` after multiple joins to `concept`.

domain_filter.description: Only used with `with: concept`. Restricts the joined concept view to these `domain_id` values.

spec.description: Dotted reference to another spec file (relative to the pipeline's formatters/ dir, without .yaml).
